case: state 'registered', not 'findable' — skipped and logged, never catalogued
provenance_note: INVENTED, derived from the dc-01 payload. The public DataCite API serves only findable DOIs: all 391 IEA-Wind-relevant DOIs reachable from the configured queries on 2026-08-31 had state 'findable', so no real registered or draft payload could be captured. The DOI uses DataCite's reserved test prefix 10.5072 so it can never collide with a real record.
note: harvest() must not yield this observation at all: a registered DOI has no indexed landing page, so a record for it would publish a dead citation. The expectation below is what map() WOULD produce — map() is total and never sees this payload in production — and 'expect_skipped' is the assertion that matters.

source.notes: Mooring line tension time series accompanying the IEA Wind Task 49 reference array. The DOI has been registered with DataCite but not released, so it is not indexed and must not be catalogued.
